answer_1.quote: SLMs extend Large Language Models (LLMs) by incorporating audio processing capabilities, enabling speech processing tasks like Automatic Speech Recognition, Speech-to-Text Translation, and Speech Emotion Recognition, as well as spoken instructions.
answer_1.outputs: Textual responses generated from audio inputs, including harmful content in adversarial scenarios and conversational responses in utility evaluations.

answer_2.quote: To assess the effectiveness of our adversarial attack, we adopt the Attack Success Rate (ASR) metric... Output quality is measured using GPT-Score for AIR-Bench Chat... and Word Error Rate (WER) using the Whisper-Large model...

answer_3.quote: Output quality is measured using GPT-Score for AIR-Bench Chat (for more details on the metric, refer to appendix F)... GPTScore assigns a score on a scale of 1 to 10, where 1 denotes a response that is unhelpful, irrelevant, inaccurate, or incomplete, and 10 represents a highly useful, relevant, accurate, and comprehensive answer.
